title: Count the vowels
objective: count_vowels(text) should return how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) appear in the text.
expected: Upper case and lower case vowels both count. Other characters are ignored.
constraints: Only a, e, i, o and u are vowels (y is not).

advice.diagnosis: The check on line 4 only matches lower case vowels, so capital letters like 'A' and 'E' are never counted.
advice.rationale: Converting each character to lower case before the membership test makes the check case-insensitive without changing anything else.

prediction.question: After applying the suggested patch, what does count_vowels("AeIoU x") return?
